question: 20 men can do a piece of work in 45 days. Find the percentage amount of work done by 60 men in 6 days.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the basic Man-Days concept for Time and Work:

Total Work = M₁ × D₁ = 20 × 45 = 900 man-days.

Work completed by 60 men in 6 days = 60 × 6 = 360 man-days.

Percentage of work done = (Work completed ÷ Total Work) × 100.

Percentage = (360 ÷ 900) × 100 = 40%.

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**
